catalog.commercial_data_policy: Keep identity, price, retailer links and ratings in the commercial catalog. Their verification does not substantiate efficacy.

policy.quantitative_product_results_require: Exact product/formulation study, applicable population and outcome, verified analysis, and approved claim.
policy.missing_evidence_meaning: Not assessed or insufficiently supported within this registry; not proof of ineffectiveness or a claim that no research exists.

policy.ranking_rule: No numerical efficacy score or product ranking is provided by this seed.
policy.approval_rule: Preview is reviewable only. Production rendering requires explicit approved review states and matching current formula; no approvals are inferred from this file.

metric_definitions.rating_direction: 0 means none; 10 means worst for dryness, tightness and irritation.
metric_definitions.change: follow-up score minus baseline; negative means less of the reported symptom.
metric_definitions.missing: Use null with a missing reason; never substitute zero.
metric_definitions.causal_interpretation: Individual self-reports track experience; they do not demonstrate treatment causality or become clinical-trial evidence.

guardrails: Do not infer TEWL, corneometry or barrier repair from a selfie.
Do not compare unstandardized before/after images as quantitative clinical outcomes.
A day-28 check-in is a tracking choice, not a promised time to benefit.
Store individual tracking data separately with explicit consent and suitable access controls; this registry contains no personal data.
